The '''Stromma''' were a strong-willed [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Oristrom]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==History==
During an early phase of their history known as the [[Expansion Period]], the Stromma engaged in hostilities with the [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Quesoth]] species. The Stromma were defeated and they became firm allies of the Quesoth. Oristrom was later captured by the forces of the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]], but Esva was eventually driven from the world by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] and the [[Empire of the Hand]]. The liberated Stromma subsequently allied themselves with the Empire of the Hand and some of them entered Imperial service aboard the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Admonitor]]''. However, in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], the Stromma envoy [[Nyama]] ordered all Stromma aboard the ''Admonitor'' to withdraw from the Imperial military and leave the Star Destroyer, because he believed that the Imperials would be defeated during an [[Attack on the Red City|upcoming attack]] against Esva's forces on the planet [[Quethold]].
